problems.title: Heat engine
problems.statement: A tall glass cylinder is half-filled with hot water and topped up with cold water. A small ampule, containing a few drops of ether or alcohol (and closed off by a rubber pipette cap), is then put in. Describe the phenomena occurring in the system. How does the motion of the ampule change with time?
